title: Your Cat Won’t Appreciate These Prime Day Deals, but You Will
author: Molly Higgins
text:

Learn more.Amazon Prime Day now happens several times a year, including Prime Big Deal Days, which run through October 6 and 7. This sales event is the best time for pet parents to snag an usually expensive automatic litter box or pet camera for much less money before prices dip again before Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales.As the pet tech reviewer on the WIRED Reviews team, I’ve tested many great pet gadgets, as well as many that don’t live up to their promises. I’ve scoured Amazon to find the best discounts on WIRED-tested pet tech that I think is actually worth buying during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days. I’ll be updating this list throughout the two-day sales event, so be sure to check back for the best deals on essentials for your furry friend. Want more Amazon Prime Day deals? Read our Absolute Best Prime Big Deal Days deals roundup.Be sure to check out our related Amazon Prime Day shopping guides to ensure you’re making the most of the sales, including How to avoid scams and sketchy wares on Amazon, Amazon Prime perks you might not know about, and Amazon Prime Day tips.Jump toBest Pet Camera DealsBest Automatic Feeder DealsBest Pet Fountain DealsBest Automatic Litter Box DealsBest Pet Camera DealsI’ve tested nearly two dozen pet cameras. They can be expensive, but I find them immensely helpful, especially when I’m out of town or when I keep finding surprise piles of puke scattered across the carpet. I recommend these models, and they just so happen to be heavily discounted right now.Photograph: Molly HigginsPetcubeCam$32 $25 (22% off) AmazonThis is a basic but solid pet camera. This is the lowest price we’ve seen this year—you can’t get much cheaper than this.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of FurboFurbo360 Dog Camera$122 $85 (30% off) Amazon$184 $54 (71% off) Furbo$131 NeweggThis pet camera has 360-degree panning and can even toss treats while you’re away. At $85, this price beats the lowest we’ve seen by 30 percent.
Best Automatic Feeder DealsAn automatic pet feeder is a godsend for pet parents with a furbaby who likes to wake you up by screaming at 3 am for food. It also gives me peace of mind while I’m away. I recommend that every pet owner have one.Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of PetkitPetkitYumShare Dual-Hopper 2 Automatic Feeder With Camera$180 $130 (28% off) Amazon$170 $146 (14% off) Petkit$170 $146 (14% off) ChewyThis is my favorite automatic feeder—it has an AI-enabled camera and is remotely controlled via an app. At $82 off, this is the lowest price we’ve seen this year.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of AmazonPetlibroGranary Smart Camera Feeder$140 $110 (21% off) Amazon$140 $123 (12% off) Chewy$140 PetlibroThis was my go-to automatic feeder for years. I love its built-in camera and intuitive, user-friendly connected app.
Best Pet Fountain DealsEnsuring your pet stays hydrated with an automatic pet fountain is one of the easiest ways to be proactive about their health, especially for cats prone to UTIs and bladder infections.Photograph: Molly HigginsPetkitEverSweet Solo SE$30 $23 (23% off) Amazon$30 PetkitIf you’re interested in trying a fountain to see if it’s right for your pet, this basic model is a good place to start—and it’s the lowest price we’ve seen this year.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of AmazonPetlibroDockstream Fountain$70 $56 (20% off) AmazonPetlibro released a second-generation version of this model earlier this year, but I still think this cordless model is worth buying. Right now, it’s also 12 percent cheaper than we’ve ever seen it.
Best Automatic Litter Box DealsAlthough they are pricey, I recommend that every single cat parent invest in an automatic litter box. Buying during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days is one of the best times to buy.Photograph: Molly HigginsPhotograph: PetkitPetkitPuraMax 2$390 $282 (28% off) Amazon$449 $370 (18% off) Walmart$500 $400 (20% off) PetkitAlthough Petkit has released a few newer models, this is still the automatic litter box I recommend to most people. It performed reliably during extended testing, and it’s currently at its lowest price of the year.
Photograph: Molly HigginsCourtesy of PetkitPetkitPurobot Max Pro 2$550 $443 (19% off) Amazon$600 $500 (17% off) Petkit$530 WayfairThis is the best overall automatic litter box, now 20 percent off. It features an AI-enabled camera and a connected app to better track and monitor usage, providing enhanced health insights.
